records.name: Kleine Nete (VMM agreement), Retie to Grobbendonk

rule.text: Open under a VMM agreement, with extra rules.
conditions: Get in and out only at the 9 put-in points.
No paddling from half an hour after sunset until sunrise.
Closed once the warning or threshold level is reached at the Retie, Herentals or Grobbendonk gauges (waterinfo.be).
Closed below 50 cm on the gauge at Retie.

link.title: VMM: paddling on the Kleine Nete

records.name: Dijle (VMM agreement), regional border to the Demer

rule.text: Open under a VMM agreement, with extra rules.
conditions: Get in only at the 11 marked points between Huldenberg and Rotselaar.
Paddle only from sunrise to half an hour after sunset.
Don't paddle at very high or very low water.

records.unverified: The water-level thresholds: the agreement PDF couldn't be read.
